parsed.reply: You can remember it through its root «reck», which means care or attention (though it's rarely used on its own today). Adding «-less» makes it «without care» — someone who acts without caring about the consequences. Also, linking it to the common collocation «reckless driving» helps anchor the meaning.
followUps: How does it differ from careless?
